theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightThreeSumHybridCore.program_meets {lim : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Limits} {fastP : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Program} {κ cutoff src n U free d : ℕ}
    (hlen : fastP.length=537) (x : Fin n→ℤ) (μ : ℕ→ℤ)
    (hn : 0<n) (hsrc : src+n≤free)
    (H : (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ThreeSumFastResourcesHybrid.need κ cutoff n U).Ok lim free d)
    (hread : ∀ i : Fin n, μ (src+i.val)=x i) (hx : ∀ i, |x i|≤(U : ℤ))
    (hfast : cutoff≤n → U≤n^κ →
      _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim fastP 536 (d+1) [src,n,free] μ
        (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightThreeSumFastDriver.time (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedTraversalCosts.colorBudget κ n) n)
        (fun r ν => (r=0 ∨ r=1) ∧ (r=1 ↔ _root_.ThreeSum.Coloring.DistinctZeroSum x) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν free)) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightThreeSumHybridCore.program fastP κ cutoff) 542 d [n,U,src,free] μ
      (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ThreeSumHybridCosts.time κ cutoff n U)
      (fun r ν => (r=0 ∨ r=1) ∧ (r=1 ↔ _root_.ThreeSum.Coloring.DistinctZeroSum x) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν free) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let the fast program have exactly 537 procedures and let $x$ be a nonempty length-$n$ integer input bounded by $U$, stored before the free pointer. Assume the complete hybrid resource predicate and a fast-procedure contract whenever the cutoff is reached and $U\le n^\kappa$. Procedure 542 of the assembled hybrid program returns a Boolean equivalent to a distinct-index zero-sum triple, preserves memory below the free pointer, and meets the exact hybrid time bound.

This composition theorem joins the concrete fast branch and original-triple fallback into one exact decision contract.
